layouts.house_scene:
COMPOSITION: a wide, opaque, painted night-time scene filling the whole 16:9 canvas edge to edge. The house is the clear hero: centred, seen from the front in a slight 3/4 view, standing on its ground about two thirds of the way down the frame, its full height taking about 60% of the canvas height, nothing cropped. A short glowing dirt path leads from the bottom of the frame to its front door. The setting around it sets the scene but stays simpler and slightly darker than the house so the house reads first. A starry night sky with the moon.
NO FOG: no mist, haze, fog banks or ground smoke anywhere; the air is perfectly clear and the whole scene is crisp and readable.

z1.name: Pumpkin Fields house
z1.prefix: The FIRST attached image is an approved house for Goated's Halloween trail. Paint it into a full scene, keeping the house EXACTLY as designed: same shape, roof, windows, door, colours, decorations and proportions. Do not redesign it. The SECOND image is only the Goated art style reference.
z1.subject: The Pumpkin Fields house in its home zone: rolling autumn farmland at night, a glowing pumpkin patch full of carved jack-o'-lanterns in pumpkin orange (#FFAA33), tall golden corn rows, a scarecrow, a crooked wooden fence, a windmill silhouette and autumn trees with red and orange leaves, a big full moon. Warm orange glow from the house windows and the lanterns.

Paint it into a full scene, keeping the building EXACTLY as designed: same towers, roofs, stained-glass window, staircase, open glowing doors, colours, decorations and proportions. z4.subject: The Haunted House on top of a rocky hill at the end of the trail: a winding stone stairway lined with flickering lanterns and jack-o'-lanterns leads up to it, old tombstones and dead trees on the slopes, a rusted iron fence with an open gate at the bottom, a huge full moon directly behind the house with bats circling the towers, a dramatic deep purple night sky. Grand and spooky, but spooky-cute, not gory.

z1.name: Z1 door open
z1.change: Open the blue front door of the red farmhouse. The front door swings WIDE OPEN (opened inwards), and the doorway is filled with bright warm golden light pouring out, spilling a soft golden glow onto the step and the path in front. Only the door and its immediate light change.

z2.name: Z2 door open

The front door swings WIDE OPEN (opened inwards), and the doorway is filled with bright warm golden light pouring out, spilling a soft golden glow onto the step and the path in front. z3.name: Z3 door shut
z3.change: The doorway is SHUT: a single dark purple-grey wooden gothic door, pointed-arch shaped to fit the doorway exactly, with iron hinges and a ring handle; NO light comes from the doorway and there is no golden light spill on the steps or path in front of it. The windows stay lit exactly as they are. Only the door and the light spill change.
